title: 第13章 狗咬吕洞宾不识好人心第14章他们天赋太差了入不了您的慧眼
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
王飞宇傻眼了。
曹浩简单的一句话，不断在他脑海中回荡。
曹浩悬浮在旁边，语速飞快地将王飞宇走后发生的一切，一字不落地复述了一遍，甚至吐沫星子都溅到了王飞宇的白手套上。
王飞宇脸色阴晴不定，目光死死地盯着曹浩，一脸不可置信，道：“不……不可能！肯定是哪里搞错了！他只是一个杂役弟子而已，怎么可能炼出上品夺灵丹，我怀疑他定是用某种手段，拿出上品夺灵丹弄虚作假，骗过了所有人！也骗过了墨尘居！”
“哼！墨尘居那个老不死的定是被猪油蒙了心，难不成他还天真地以为陆成是靠真本事炼出来吗！呸！他就是一个废物杂役弟子而已！”
“此刻竟然还去认证一品炼丹师，真是作死啊！”
“墨尘居那个老匹夫，脾气贼臭，这次恐怕又要成为青玄宗的笑柄了，哈哈哈！！”
“走！老子倒要看看，这个废物，如何将自己的命运掌握在自己手中？！”
曹浩先行一步离去，王飞宇厌恶地看了一眼白手套，连忙又换了一双白手套，御剑紧跟其后。
一刻钟后，王飞宇和曹浩等人来到丹峰。
丹峰比补天峰看起来还高还大，山峰直入云霄，看起来波澜壮阔。
但山顶仿佛被人一剑凭空削去了山尖部分，只留下一片平地的山峰伫立着，而在山顶的平地上，早已人满为患，黑压压的头，看起来足有上万人。
往日青玄宗有弟子认证炼丹师，是没有这么多人的，但只要墨尘居带弟子来认证，此地便异常火爆，原因也是非常奇葩，墨尘居所带来的弟子竟没有一个能炼出极品丹药的，他也成为青玄宗的笑柄！
王飞宇作为内门长老的孙子，身份显赫，一路畅通无阻，很自然地来到平地前列，看到站在首位面朝大家的面带笑容的陆成，他眼中毫无掩饰地露出杀意！
陆成也感受到这股杀意，看向王飞宇的方向，嘴角微微勾起，露出一丝讥讽的笑容。
陆成旁边，墨尘居则是眉头皱起，面带不悦，都来一刻钟了，何念慈和吴长风还不来，他刚要拿出传音石。
这时，天空远处突然响起数道破空声。
飞在前列的两位，正是青玄宗另外两名三品炼丹师，何念慈和吴长风！
他二人身后，各跟着几位身穿白袍的弟子，这些弟子胸口均雕刻着两道花纹，是二品炼丹师！
何念慈和吴长风身后的弟子老远也看到了站在首位的陆成，待看到陆成身上的杂役服饰后，也是微微一愣，紧跟着脸上露出厌恶和嘲讽的表情，一脸失望地摇了摇头。

何念慈刚一落地，目光便看向陆成，微微一愣，顿时讥讽道：“墨大师选弟子的眼光真是越来越毒辣了，呵……竟选一个炼气一层的杂役弟子为徒！”
吴长风目光也上下打量着陆成，嗤笑道：“呵呵……垃圾师父收一个垃圾徒弟，倒也般配！”
陆成看向他们，心生疑惑，为何他的师父墨尘居一个一品和二品的炼丹师都没有？
而他们却有数位？
墨尘居耳边传来何念慈和吴长风的嘲笑声，脸色瞬间阴沉，身上一股筑基大圆满的恐怖灵气骤然涌出，直接压向两人，低沉道：“两位，要不要和老夫打一场？”
何念慈和吴长风瞬间嘴角一僵，显然被这股强大的气场吓到，不敢再出言嘲讽。
而远处前来观看的上万青玄宗弟子，除了方才在补天峰后院的几位青袍弟子外，不少人看向陆成的眼神也是颇为奇怪。
当然，也有例外！
陆成眸若深潭，晶亮幽深，神仪明秀，风度翩然，一身灰色杂役服饰，长发飘逸在他的身后，浑身上下都散发着一股飘逸出神的气息，再加上只有炼气一层，看上去很是羸弱白嫩……活脱脱一个小白脸！
各种嫉妒、不甘、嘲讽、羡慕、不屑的目光集中在陆成的身上。
他仿佛无知无觉，脸上始终带着几分云淡风轻的笑容，倒是将不少女弟子看得丢了魂魄一般眼神迷离。
墨尘居看了陆成一眼，对他浑身散发的这股淡然气势感到惊讶，陆成在万众瞩目下依旧能保持从容姿态的模样，光是这份心态，就应该是一个天才该有的气势！
没来由的，他方才被何念慈和吴长风嘲讽的怒意逐渐消散。
他的心情逐渐舒畅，脸上皱纹逐渐散开，露出笑容。
content_en:
Wang Feiyu was dumbfounded.
Cao Hao's simple words kept echoing in his mind.
Cao Hao was floating next to him, speaking quickly and reciting everything that happened after Wang Feiyu left, word for word, and even the spitting stars splashed on Wang Feiyu's white gloves.
Wang Feiyu's face was uncertain, his eyes were fixed on Cao Hao, with a look of disbelief on his face, and he said: "No...impossible! There must be something wrong! He is just a handyman disciple, how could he refine the high-grade spirit-seizing elixir? I suspect that he must have used some means to use the high-grade spirit-seizing elixir to deceive everyone, and he also deceived Mo Chenju!"
"Hmph! That old man in Mo Chenju must have been blinded by lard. Could it be that he still naively thought that Lu Cheng relied on his real skills to make it! Bah! He is just a useless handyman disciple!"
"At this moment, you are going to be certified as a first-grade alchemist. You are really seeking death!"
"That old man in Mo Chenju has a bad temper. I'm afraid he will become the laughing stock of Qingxuan Sect again this time, hahaha!!"
"Let's go! I want to see how this loser can control his own destiny in his own hands?!"
Cao Hao left first. Wang Feiyu glanced at the white gloves with disgust and quickly changed into another pair of white gloves. Yu Jian followed closely behind.
A quarter of an hour later, Wang Feiyu, Cao Hao and others arrived at Danfeng.
Danfeng looks taller and bigger than Butianfeng. The peak reaches straight into the sky and looks magnificent.
But the top of the mountain seemed to have been cut off by someone with a sword out of thin air, leaving only a flat mountain peak standing there. And on the flat ground at the top of the mountain, it was already overcrowded, and the number of black heads seemed to be tens of thousands.
In the past, Qingxuan Sect had disciples who were certified as alchemists, but there were not so many of them. But as long as Mo Chenju brings disciples to be certified, the place becomes extremely popular. The reason is also very strange. None of the disciples brought by Mo Chenju can refine top-quality elixirs, and he has become the laughing stock of Qingxuan Sect!
As the grandson of the inner sect elder, Wang Feiyu had a distinguished status and had an unobstructed journey. He naturally came to the front of the plain. When he saw the smiling Lu Cheng standing at the front facing everyone, there was no concealment of murderous intent in his eyes!
Lu Cheng also felt the killing intent and looked in the direction of Wang Feiyu, with the corners of his mouth slightly raised into a sarcastic smile.
Next to Lu Cheng, Mo Chenju frowned with an unhappy look on his face. It had been a quarter of an hour since He Nianci and Wu Changfeng came, and he was about to take out the sound transmission stone.
At this time, several piercing sounds suddenly sounded in the distance in the sky.
The two people flying in the front were none other than the other two third-level alchemists of Qingxuan Sect, He Nianci and Wu Changfeng!
Behind the two of them, there were several disciples wearing white robes. These disciples had two patterns carved on their chests. They were second-grade alchemists!
The disciples behind He Nianci and Wu Changfeng also saw Lu Cheng standing in the first place from a distance. When they saw the handyman clothes on Lu Cheng, they were also slightly startled, followed by expressions of disgust and ridicule on their faces, and shook their heads in disappointment.
As soon as He Nianci landed on the ground, he looked at Lu Cheng. He was slightly startled, and then said sarcastically: "Master Mo's vision in choosing his disciples is getting more and more vicious. Ha...he actually chose a handyman disciple at the first level of Qi Refining as his disciple!"
Wu Changfeng also looked at Lu Cheng up and down, and sneered: "Haha... it's quite fitting for a rubbish master to have a rubbish apprentice!"
Lu Cheng looked at them, wondering why his master Mo Chenju didn't have a first or second grade alchemist?
And they have numbers?
Mo Chenju heard the mocking sounds of He Nianci and Wu Changfeng in his ears. His face instantly became gloomy, and a terrifying aura of foundation-building perfection suddenly surged out of his body, directly pressing against the two of them. He said in a low voice: "You two, do you want to have a fight with me?"
He Nianci and Wu Changfeng's mouths froze instantly. They were obviously frightened by this powerful aura and did not dare to taunt them any more.
As for the tens of thousands of Qingxuanzong disciples who came to watch from a distance, except those who were just hereExcept for the few green-robed disciples in the backyard of Butian Peak, many people looked at Lu Cheng in strange ways.
Of course, there are exceptions!
Lu Cheng's eyes are as bright as a deep pool, his demeanor is bright and graceful, he is dressed in gray handyman clothes, his long hair is flowing behind him, and his whole body exudes an elegant and trance-like aura. In addition, he only has one level of Qi refining, and he looks very weak and tender... just like a pretty boy!
All kinds of jealousy, unwillingness, ridicule, envy, and disdain were focused on Lu Cheng.
He seemed to be unaware, and always had a faint smile on his face, but his eyes were blurred and made many female disciples lose their souls.
Mo Chenju glanced at Lu Cheng and was surprised by the calm aura he exuded. Lu Cheng could still maintain a calm posture under the spotlight. This mentality alone should be the aura of a genius!
For no reason, his anger at being mocked by He Nianci and Wu Changfeng gradually dissipated.
His mood gradually relaxed, and the wrinkles on his face gradually faded, revealing a smile.
